events.title: Spell Unbound is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46279704/1d8492a6483c3180964b5ceb50a038f625d67a0c.gif Spell Unbound is in Steam Next Fest. Draw a loop round a monster with the mouse and it is bound; that is your only spell. Bosses lose a piece with every loop. The demo is the whole descent: five acts, 35 floors and five bosses, down to Slagheart, with a secret area to find on the way. It stays up after the fest. Played it already? An honest review on the demo page helps us more than anything: https://store.steampowered.com/

events.title: New Pages: "The Estate"
events.summary: Greetings & FeedbackHello, Scribes! We've been hard at work getting ready for October's Next Fest. As things stand right now, all of our progression and content has been implemented; it just needs to be tested and balanced. We have been hearing some feedback regarding game difficulty. To help with this, we added a new setting (enabled by default) that allows players to see their hitbox. events.title: The Spell Unbound Demo is Live
events.summary: Greetings Hello Scribes! This is the first of hopefully many devlogs, and while I'm new to this hopefully we can all get a good flow going. First things first Spell Unbound!! Our demo is finally out!We initially intended to go live with it last week, but decided that another week would allow us to put our best, first foot forward. Now the next question, or rather better question: "What is Spell Unbound?"It's a Singleplayer Rogue-lite, that gets it's combat inspiration from Pokémon Rescue Ranger.
